transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I guess… I came in because when I start eating like that, it feels like something flips. I keep going, even when part of me is thinking, “Dennis, just stop already.”
Do you feel like you're in control while you're eating during these episodes?
Not really. Once I start, it’s like… some switch gets hit, and I just keep going, even though part of me is telling myself to stop.
Do you feel guilty after these eating episodes?

Yeah… I do. Mostly I feel embarrassed, and kind of disgusted with myself afterward. It’s hard because I’m usually pretty disciplined with school and robotics, so it makes me feel like I’m not really in control.
Do you ever try to make up for what you've eaten during these episodes by doing something to counteract it?
Um… I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I don’t really think I have anything specific like that to say.
Do you ever try to vomit or purge after one of these eating episodes?
No… I don’t do that. I mean, I might feel bad afterward, but I don’t make myself throw up or anything.
How often do these eating episodes happen?

Um… most weeks, I guess. Usually it’s like one night, sometimes two if there’s a lot going on with deadlines or food sitting around the apartment. It’s been that way since early in the semester… maybe three or four months.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
Not really… I mean, I don’t weigh myself much. My clothes feel about the same, I think.
Do you severely restrict your food intake between these eating episodes?
I don’t think so… I mean, I might eat less the next day just because I feel kind of off, but I’m not like… trying to starve myself or anything.
Do you exercise more than usual after one of these eating episodes?
Not really. I mean, I might feel bad about it, but I don’t go work out extra or anything.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without feeling like you've lost control?
No… I mean, the problem is more that I do feel like I lose control. Once I start, it’s like a switch flips and I keep going, even while I’m thinking, “Dennis, stop already.”
Have these episodes of feeling like you've lost control while eating been happening for more than 3 months?
Yeah… I think so. It started early in the semester, and it’s been most weeks since then. Usually one night, sometimes two if things pile up. So… probably like three or four months now.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time, feel like you've lost control, and this happens at least once a week?
Yeah… that sounds right. Since early in the semester it’s been most weeks, usually one night, sometimes two if things pile up. It’s been like that for maybe three or four months.
Do you ever use laxatives or diuretics to try to counteract the effects of your eating episodes?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t used anything like that.
Do you feel like these episodes are a moral failing or something is deeply wrong with you when they happen?

Yeah… kind of. I wouldn’t say “moral failing,” exactly, but afterward I feel really embarrassed and sort of grossed out with myself. I’m usually pretty disciplined with school and robotics, so it makes me feel like… I don’t know, like I’m not in control.
Do you feel extremely guilty or worthless after these eating episodes, beyond just feeling embarrassed or disgusted with yourself?

I don’t know if I’d say worthless, exactly. It’s more… I feel really embarrassed and kind of grossed out with myself afterward. Like I’m usually pretty disciplined with school and robotics, so it makes me feel like I’m just not in control.
Have you noticed any periods of significant weight gain or loss over the past few months?
Um… not really. I don’t think there’s been anything significant. I haven’t been tracking it closely, though.
Do you ever exercise excessively after one of these eating episodes to try to burn off the calories?
Not really. I mean, I might feel bad afterward, but I don’t go work out or anything to make up for it.
Do you feel like you hate yourself after these eating episodes?
I don’t think I’d call it hate. It’s more like… I feel really embarrassed and kind of grossed out with myself afterward. Like I should’ve had more control.
Do you feel like these episodes are a sign of a deep personal flaw?

I don’t know if I’d say a deep flaw. It just… makes me feel embarrassed, and kind of grossed out with myself. I’m usually pretty disciplined with school and robotics, so when I can’t control that, it feels bad.
Do you ever fast or severely restrict your food intake for a period of time after one of these eating episodes?
I don’t really think so. I might tell myself I should “eat better” after, but I don’t usually go without food or do anything extreme like that.
